{{Top|leg}}
'''Trells''' were arboreal predators found on [[Trellar Yagen (planet)|Trellar Yagen]]. They were a fast and vicious creature that the [[Bovorian]]s hunted for a challenge. Their skin produced a soft and supple [[Leather/Legends|leather]] that was highly prized by consumers.
